title: This Glass Drop Can Shrug Off a Bullet

scenes.text: This glass drop can shrug off a bullet.
It's called a Prince Rupert's drop. You make it by dropping hot molten glass into cold water.
The outside cools first, so the head ends up squeezed with stress of about 50 tons per square inch.
Shot at the right angle, a .22 bullet bounces off the head.
But snap the thin tail, and the whole drop explodes, with cracks racing faster than 4,000 miles an hour.
Bulletproof head. Fragile tail. One snap.

description:
A Prince Rupert's drop is made by dropping hot molten glass into cold water.
Its head can bounce off a bullet, yet snapping the tail makes the whole thing explode.
Cracks race through it faster than 4,000 miles an hour.
Would you have guessed glass could do that?
first_comment: Would you guess the head or the tail was the weak spot?
